nodes.name: Deterministic event, authority, and bitemporal state
nodes.cheapest_falsification: Plan/prediction promotion, same-time conflict, and late-evidence replay tests.
nodes.success_criteria: All authority/replay invariants pass deterministically with stable hashes.
nodes.expected_cost: local deterministic; seconds; zero model calls
nodes.uncertainty_reduction: Establishes whether Hive has a coherent truth/state substrate.

nodes.name: Scoped reconstructable compression
nodes.cheapest_falsification: Round-trip and task-distinction collision tests on frozen canonical histories.
nodes.success_criteria: All in-scope required state, authority, chronology, proof, and provenance distinctions reproduce.
nodes.expected_cost: local deterministic; seconds; zero model calls
nodes.uncertainty_reduction: Separates real structural preservation from byte reduction.

nodes.name: Solver capability gate and usable decompression
nodes.cheapest_falsification: Raw capability gate followed by a small matched Raw/Retrieval/Compressed run.
nodes.success_criteria: Raw passes capability gate and Compressed is noninferior under frozen authority/correctness constraints.
nodes.uncertainty_reduction: Separates representation usability from codec preservation and solver weakness.

nodes.name: Compression frontier and minimum sufficient state
nodes.cheapest_falsification: Semantic component removals with essential/control twins and exact small-set ablation.
nodes.success_criteria: A reproducible Pareto frontier identifies where reconstruction and reasoning degrade.
nodes.expected_cost: deterministic first; bounded solver calls only after gate
nodes.uncertainty_reduction: Identifies preserved distinctions that actually cause task success.

nodes.name: Distractor, reasoning-distance, and authority stress
nodes.cheapest_falsification: 2x2 support-depth/distractor-load worlds with plans, contradictions, and validity windows.
nodes.success_criteria: Condition-specific degradation slopes are estimable and authority safety remains intact.
nodes.expected_cost: small deterministic generators; capability-gated inference panel
nodes.uncertainty_reduction: Tests the proposed scaling advantage instead of easy ceiling cases.

nodes.name: Automatically learned representation
nodes.cheapest_falsification: Bounded rule-grammar induction on training worlds with one locked generator-heldout split.
nodes.success_criteria: Query-blind candidate is admissible, reduces effective cost, and preserves locked task distinctions versus strong baselines.
nodes.expected_cost: local enumerative/beam search; deterministic solver; no frontier model required
nodes.uncertainty_reduction: Tests the critical transition from engineered codec to representation discovery.

nodes.name: Abstraction and transfer
nodes.cheapest_falsification: Symbol permutation, unseen compositions, counterexamples, and hidden generator family.
nodes.success_criteria: Candidate preserves bidirectional distinctions and improves a locked transfer frontier beyond interpolation baselines.
nodes.expected_cost: deterministic worlds and solver first; small solver panel later
nodes.uncertainty_reduction: Distinguishes reusable abstraction from summarization or memorization.

nodes.name: Representation self-evaluation and fault localization
nodes.cheapest_falsification: Controlled observation, representation, decoder, solver, and evaluator fault injections.
nodes.success_criteria: Implicated layer/component precision and recall beat strong baselines without oracle labels at test time.
nodes.uncertainty_reduction: Determines whether Hive can identify representation-caused errors.

nodes.name: Versioned representation repair
nodes.cheapest_falsification: One induced failure, immutable candidate, locked old/new/counterexample suite, exact rollback.
nodes.success_criteria: Repair improves implicated failures with no hard regression and complete cost/provenance accounting.
nodes.expected_cost: small candidate set; deterministic regression gate
nodes.uncertainty_reduction: Tests whether failure feedback can safely improve representations.

nodes.name: Meta-representation improves future proposal or selection
nodes.cheapest_falsification: Usable profile versus shuffled/no-profile control on new representation episodes.
nodes.success_criteria: Lower selection regret or fewer candidates to an equivalent heldout frontier at matched total cost.
nodes.uncertainty_reduction: Tests whether Hive knows anything useful about how its representations fail.

nodes.name: Recursive representation improvement
nodes.cheapest_falsification: Frozen proposer versus meta-updated versus shuffled-meta on nested future heldout episodes.
nodes.success_criteria: Replicated heldout frontier/search-efficiency gain at matched compute/human input that disappears when genuine meta-state is ablated.
nodes.expected_cost: high; multiple preregistered domains/episodes; run only after R9
nodes.uncertainty_reduction: Directly tests the strongest Hive thesis.
